speaker: Unknown
en: Let's get started.
zh: 让我们开始吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hi, everyone.
zh: 大家好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thank you for coming.
zh: 感谢各位的到来。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the late afternoon in the last day, so I really appreciate it.
zh: 现在是最后一天的傍晚时分,所以我真的很感激。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm Gon, founder and CEO of Friendly AI.
zh: 我是 Gon,Friendly AI 的创始人兼 CEO。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, I want to talk about agentic inference.
zh: 今天,我想谈谈智能体推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'll first walk through what changed, why it matters, and how we rebuilt the inference cloud for agents.
zh: 所以我会先讲讲发生了什么变化、为什么这很重要,以及我们如何为智能体重建了推理云。

speaker: Unknown
en: Before we go deeper, let me briefly introduce Friendly AI.
zh: 在深入之前,让我简要介绍一下 Friendly AI。

speaker: Unknown
en: Friendly AI is the frontier AI inference cloud for agents.
zh: Friendly AI 是面向智能体的前沿 AI 推理云。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we run inference for agents at scale, faster, cheaper, and more reliably.
zh: 我们为智能体大规模运行推理,更快、更便宜、更可靠。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are born from a research team at Seoul National University, and those research routes still define us.
zh: 我们诞生于首尔国立大学的一个研究团队,那些研究渊源仍然定义着我们。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are the team that invented continuous batching.
zh: 我们是发明了 continuous batching 的团队。

speaker: Unknown
en: The inference optimization that is now standard across the industry and our old car work inspired 3LLM, a widely used open source framework.
zh: 这项推理优化如今已成为全行业的标准,而我们早年的工作启发了 3LLM,一个被广泛使用的开源框架。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today we operate globally, headquartered in San Francisco with a team in Seoul to scale frontier inference.
zh: 今天我们全球运营,总部位于旧金山,在首尔设有一个团队,以扩展前沿推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: As you know, 2026 is the year agents go into massive production and it's driven by two trends coming together.
zh: 如你所知,2026 年是智能体大规模进入生产环境的年份,这是由两个趋势汇聚驱动的。

speaker: Unknown
en: First, agents are going exponential.
zh: 第一,智能体正在指数级增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: AI agents are driving explosive adoption across software, operations, and knowledge work.
zh: AI 智能体正在软件、运营和知识工作中推动爆发式的采用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Second, open-rate motors have reached the frontier and make agents economical.
zh: 第二,开放权重模型已经达到前沿水平,并使智能体变得经济可行。

speaker: Unknown
en: They now rival close-frontier motors in capability, which means you can run frontier-quality agents on open motors with much lower token costs.
zh: 它们现在可以与闭源前沿模型在能力上抗衡,这意味着你可以在开放模型上以低得多的 token 成本运行前沿质量的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me make the open-weight model part concrete.
zh: 让我把开放权重模型这部分讲得更具体一些。

speaker: Unknown
en: Open-weight models are now strong enough for these types of real-agentic workflows.
zh: 开放权重模型现在已足够强大,可以应对这类真实的智能体工作流。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here, we gave the exact same task, building a tower defense game with a coding agent to two models.
zh: 在这里,我们给两个模型完全相同的任务——用编码智能体构建一个塔防游戏。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the left is GLM 5.2, an open-weight model running on friendly AI.
zh: 左边是 GLM 5.2,一个在 Friendly AI 上运行的开放权重模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the right is Anthropix, Opus 4.8.
zh: 右边是 Anthropix 的 Opus 4.8。

speaker: Unknown
en: The important point is not that the outputs are identical.
zh: 重点不是它们的输出完全相同。

speaker: Unknown
en: The point is that both complete the task at a level that is clearly usable.
zh: 重点在于两者完成任务的水平都明显可用。

speaker: Unknown
en: For many agentic workflows, open-weight models have crossed the quality threshold.
zh: 对于许多智能体工作流来说,开放权重模型已经跨过了质量阈值。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the economics are very different.
zh: 但经济性是非常不同的。

speaker: Unknown
en: For the same task, Opus 4.8 costs about $1.50.
zh: 对于同样的任务,Opus 4.8 的成本约为 1.50 美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: GLM 5.2 unfriendly AI costs $0.27.
zh: GLM 5.2 在 Friendly AI 上成本为 0.27 美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: But 5.6 times cheaper.
zh: 便宜了 5.6 倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is the promise I mentioned earlier.
zh: 所以这就是我之前提到的承诺。

speaker: Unknown
en: Openweight models give you frontier quality agents at a fraction of the cost.
zh: 开放权重模型让你以几分之一的成本获得前沿质量的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: But motor cost is only one part of the story.
zh: 但模型成本只是故事的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: To make agents actually fast and reliable, the inference stack itself has to change.
zh: 要让智能体真正快速和可靠,推理栈本身必须改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: So let's look at what actually happens inside an agentic workload.
zh: 那么让我们看看智能体工作负载内部实际发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: So first, let's look at changes in the workload.
zh: 首先,让我们看看工作负载的变化。

speaker: Unknown
en: In the past, the dominant usage was checked.
zh: 在过去,主导的用法是聊天。

speaker: Unknown
en: The basic unit was a request.
zh: 基本单元是请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: A person asks a question, the model answers, and the person reads it.
zh: 一个人问一个问题,模型回答,然后这个人阅读。

speaker: Unknown
en: Latency meant, how fast did I get one response?
zh: 延迟意味着,我多快得到一个响应?

speaker: Unknown
en: Agents are different.
zh: 智能体是不同的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The basic unit is a task.
zh: 基本单元是任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: A task may involve many model cores, many tool cores, and it may run autonomously for a while.
zh: 一个任务可能涉及许多模型调用、许多工具调用,并且它可能会自主运行一段时间。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the user does not really care about the latency of one individual request.
zh: 所以用户其实并不在乎单个请求的延迟。

speaker: Unknown
en: The user cares about when the whole task is completed.
zh: 用户在乎的是整个任务何时完成。

speaker: Unknown
en: That means we have to optimize for tasks, not just individual requests.
zh: 这意味着我们必须为任务进行优化,而不仅仅是单个请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's look at agent to grow close more closely.
zh: 让我们更仔细地看看智能体循环。

speaker: Unknown
en: An agent really runs a session made up of tasks.
zh: 智能体实际上运行的是由任务组成的会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Each task typically runs in a loop.
zh: 每个任务通常运行在一个循环中。

speaker: Unknown
en: First it plans, which usually means an LLM call.
zh: 首先它进行规划,这通常意味着一次 LLM 调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then it acts maybe by calling a tool.
zh: 然后它执行动作,可能是通过调用一个工具。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then it observes the result and adds that back into the context.
zh: 然后它观察结果,并把结果加回到上下文中。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it repeats this until the task is done.
zh: 然后它不断重复这个过程,直到任务完成。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we are constantly alternating between LLM inference and one or more non-LLM tool executions.
zh: 所以我们在 LLM 推理和一个或多个非 LLM 的工具执行之间不断交替。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there is a gap between LLM calls.
zh: 所以 LLM 调用之间存在间隙。

speaker: Unknown
en: An agent can also create sub-agents and run them in parallel.
zh: 智能体还可以创建子智能体,并并行运行它们。

speaker: Unknown
en: Agent inputs also look very different from chat.
zh: 智能体的输入看起来也和聊天非常不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: The graph here shows the prompt and completion length distributions of our internal coding agent ones with GLM 5.2, which we use day-to-day.
zh: 这里的图显示了我们内部编码智能体的提示词和补全长度分布,它们使用 GLM 5.2,我们每天都在用。

speaker: Unknown
en: They are much longer.
zh: 它们要长得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: They grow as the task progresses since every observation gets appended back into the context.
zh: 它们随着任务推进而增长,因为每次观察都会被追加回上下文中。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's an important pattern here.
zh: 这里有一个重要的模式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Consecutive agent steps usually share a huge prefix.
zh: 相邻的智能体步骤通常共享一个巨大的前缀。

speaker: Unknown
en: If we recompute that same prefix every time, we are burning a lot of compute on work we already did.
zh: 如果我们每次都重新计算相同的前缀,我们就会在已经做过的工作上烧掉大量算力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is one of the biggest opportunities in agentic inference.
zh: 所以这是智能体推理中最大的机会之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how token hungry are agents?
zh: 那么智能体有多吃 token 呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Now let's look at a long horizon test example like deep research.
zh: 现在我们来看一个长时程测试的例子,比如深度研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: We ran explain the spec decoding framework in VLLM using Claude Code with GLM 5.2 on friendly AI.
zh: 我们用 Claude Code 和 GLM 5.2 在 friendly AI 上运行了“解释 VLLM 中的 spec decoding 框架”。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are multiple stages and each stage is composed of sub-agents which run multiple inferences and tool cores.
zh: 这有多个阶段,每个阶段由多个子智能体组成,它们运行多次推理和工具调用。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it might run tens or even hundreds of inference steps, sometimes over minutes or hours.
zh: 所以它可能运行数十甚至数百个推理步骤,有时持续几分钟甚至几小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the shared context keeps going the whole time.
zh: 而且共享的上下文全程都在持续增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: For the user, what matters is not the latency of a single token or one core.
zh: 对用户来说,重要的不是单个 token 或一次调用的延迟。

speaker: Unknown
en: What matters is, when is my task completed?
zh: 重要的是,我的任务什么时候完成?

speaker: Unknown
en: So agency inference is not just chat with more requests.
zh: 所以智能体推理不仅仅是带更多请求的聊天。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a different problem.
zh: 它是一个不同的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: The context grows over time.
zh: 上下文随时间增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: Tool work is interleaved between model cores.
zh: 工具工作交错在模型调用之间。

speaker: Unknown
en: The number of motor cores depends on the input, so you can't really plan around a fixed request rate plan.
zh: 工具调用的数量取决于输入,所以你没法围绕一个固定的请求速率计划来做规划。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the real metric is end-to-end test latency, not a single request latency.
zh: 而真正的指标是端到端测试延迟,而不是单次请求延迟。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is where Friendly AI comes in.
zh: 这就是 friendly AI 的用武之地。

speaker: Unknown
en: We rebuilt the Frontier Inference Cloud specifically for agency goal codes around the challenges I just walked through.
zh: 我们围绕我刚刚讲过的挑战,专门为智能体目标重建了 Frontier Inference Cloud。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we set one goal, optimize end-to-end task latency, the task, not just the request.
zh: 我们设定了一个目标:优化端到端任务延迟,是任务,而不仅仅是请求。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how do we do that?
zh: 那么我们是怎么做到的呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Let me show you the key engineering behind it.
zh: 让我给你展示它背后的关键工程。

speaker: Unknown
en: Here's the engineering map for how we think about it.
zh: 这是我们思考这个问题方式的工程地图。

speaker: Unknown
en: We built the stack layer by layer around agent-equal clause.
zh: 我们围绕智能体逐层构建了整个技术栈。

speaker: Unknown
en: There are four big pillars I'm going to cover today, prefix caching,
zh: 我今天要讲四大支柱:前缀缓存,

speaker: Unknown
en: Key value, in short, KB, cache management, cache-aware routing, agent-aware optimization.
zh: 键值,简称 KB,缓存管理、缓存感知路由、智能体感知优化。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, of course, underneath, we need model layer optimization like sparse attention for long contacts, techniques to reduce errors, fast corners, resilient serving, and more.
zh: 当然,在底层,我们还需要模型层优化,比如针对长上下文的稀疏注意力、减少错误的技术、快速角落、弹性服务等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this talk, I'm going to focus on the four pillars.
zh: 在这次演讲中,我将聚焦于这四大支柱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's start with prefix caching.
zh: 让我们从-prefix-caching-开始。让我们从前缀缓存开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: Since agent steps share a large prefix, we compute key value for the prefix ones and cache it.
zh: 由于智能体步骤共享一个很大的前缀,我们对前缀只计算一次键值并缓存它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then on later steps, we reuse the cache key value and only process the new suffix.
zh: 然后在后续步骤中,我们复用缓存的键值,只处理新的后缀。

speaker: Unknown
en: Reading from cache is much cheaper than with computing pre-fill, so this improves time to first token and reduces compute on every step.
zh: 从缓存读取比计算预填充便宜得多,所以这改善了首 token 时间,并减少了每一步的算力消耗。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the longer the task runs in agents, the more valuable this becomes.
zh: 而且任务在智能体中运行得越久,这就越有价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: But caching only works if the KV cache actually fits and can move around efficiently.
zh: 但缓存只有在 KV 缓存真正装得下并且能够高效移动时才有效。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we need strong KV cache management.
zh: 所以我们需要强大的 KV 缓存管理。

speaker: Unknown
en: We use frugal memory management to pack more active contacts onto each GPU memory.
zh: 我们使用节俭的内存管理,把更多的活跃上下文打包进每个 GPU 的内存。

speaker: Unknown
en: We use KV quantization to reduce the memory footprint.
zh: 我们使用 KV 量化来减少内存占用。

speaker: Unknown
en: We use hierarchical caching across GPU memory, host memory, and disk, so we can go beyond GPU limits.
zh: 我们使用跨 GPU 内存、主机内存和磁盘的分层缓存,这样我们可以突破 GPU 的限制。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we also use distributed caching, so one prefix can be served across replicas, not just inside one instance.
zh: 我们还使用分布式缓存,这样一个前缀可以跨副本提供服务,而不只是在一个实例内部。

speaker: Unknown
en: At global cluster scale, routing becomes really important.
zh: 在全局集群规模下,路由变得非常重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: A naive load relancer may spread requests evenly across GPU clusters, but it can destroy cache locality.
zh: 一个朴素的负载均衡器可能会把请求均匀地分散到各个 GPU 集群,但这会破坏缓存局部性。

speaker: Unknown
en: A cache-aware router at a global scale does something smarter.
zh: 一个全局规模的缓存感知路由器会做更聪明的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: It sends a request to a pod that already has the right prefix cached, turning a core prefill into a warm cache sheet.
zh: 它把请求发送到已经缓存了正确前缀的 pod 上,把一次冷启动预填充变成一次热缓存命中。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the same time, it still has to balance load, so one path doesn't become a hotspot.
zh: 同时,它仍然要平衡负载,这样某条路径才不会成为热点。

speaker: Unknown
en: In this example, the two requests of task A go to the same path one for cache locality.
zh: 在这个例子中,任务 A 的两个请求被发送到同一路径以获得缓存局部性。

speaker: Unknown
en: The next piece is agent-aware optimization, and this is the next frontier of agent inference.
zh: 下一部分是智能体感知优化,这是智能体推理的下一个前沿。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, most systems schedule each LLM core as if it were independent.
zh: 今天,大多数系统调度每个 LLM 核心调用时都把它当作独立的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They don't really understand that this core is part of a longer agent program.
zh: 它们并不真正理解这个核心调用是一个更长的智能体程序的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if the optimizer knows the agent-level context, it can make better decisions.
zh: 但如果优化器知道智能体层面的上下文,它就能做出更好的决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: For example, preempting the right work, speculative
zh: 比如,抢占正确的工作、投机

speaker: Unknown
en: Typically pre-filling context for a likely next step or making a better cache eviction decision based on agent-level context.
zh: 通常是为可能的下一步预填充上下文,或者基于智能体层面的上下文做出更好的缓存淘汰决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the goal is to reduce end-to-end test latency, not just make one call look fast.
zh: 所以目标是降低端到端任务延迟,而不只是让单次调用看起来很快。

speaker: Unknown
en: When we put all of this together, this is a payoff.
zh: 当我们把所有这些整合在一起,效果如下。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are using the same model, GLM 5.2, with Kilo code to create a simple mobile game.
zh: 我们使用同一个模型 GLM 5.2,用 Kilo code 来创建一个简单的手机游戏。

speaker: Unknown
en: We ran the same task with model APIs of FriendlyAI and another well-known inference provider.
zh: 我们用 FriendlyAI 的模型 API 和另一家知名推理提供商运行了同样的任务。

speaker: Unknown
en: As you can see, FriendlyAI completes the same task end-to-end to act faster thanks to our agent-centric cloud design.
zh: 如你所见,得益于我们以智能体为中心的云设计,FriendlyAI 端到端完成同样任务的速度更快。

speaker: Unknown
en: So what does this unlock in practice?
zh: 那么这在实践中能解锁什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: A stronger production agent stack.
zh: 一个更强的生产级智能体技术栈。

speaker: Unknown
en: Take an agent you already like.
zh: 拿一个你已经喜欢的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now plug-in open-weight frontier models like GLM 5.2, Minimax, and Kimi served on friendly AI.
zh: 现在接入开放权重的前沿模型,比如 GLM 5.2、Minimax 和 Kimi,由 Friendly AI 提供服务。

speaker: Unknown
en: The model gives you frontier quality capability and better economics.
zh: 模型给你前沿水准的能力和更好的经济性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Friendly AI gives you the speed, reliability, and end-to-end task performance needed in production.
zh: Friendly AI 给你生产环境中所需的速度、可靠性和端到端任务性能。

speaker: Unknown
en: That combination, quality, speed, reliability, and cost is what makes agents actually useful and economical in production.
zh: 这种组合——质量、速度、可靠性和成本——正是让智能体在生产环境中真正有用且经济实惠的关键。

speaker: Unknown
en: Friendly AI is currently powering teams in production from AI-native startups to global enterprises.
zh: Friendly AI 目前正在为从 AI 原生初创公司到全球企业的生产环境团队提供支持。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'd like to highlight a couple here.
zh: 我想在这里重点介绍几个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Hilo is a hugely popular agentic AI coding tool serving millions of users.
zh: Hilo 是一个非常流行的智能体 AI 编程工具,服务着数百万用户。

speaker: Unknown
en: LG is a global enterprise whose businesses range from electronics to healthcare to energy.
zh: LG 是一家全球企业,业务涵盖电子产品、医疗保健和能源。

speaker: Unknown
en: Very different companies, but they all need the same thing, fast, reliable, cost-effective agentic inference.
zh: 非常不同的公司,但它们都需要同样的东西——快速、可靠、高性价比的智能体推理。

speaker: Unknown
en: This testimonial from our client, Hilo, says it all.
zh: 来自我们客户 Hilo 的这份推荐说得很清楚。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over the past year, Claude Code has tested several inference providers hosting both open and closed models.
zh: 在过去一年中,Claude Code 测试了多家托管开放和闭源模型的推理提供商。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a split test of GLM-5 usage compared against other third-party providers and direct usage from the Model Lab G.AI, Friendly AI was consistently seven times faster with a significantly lower error rate.
zh: 在 GLM-5 使用量的对比测试中,与其他第三方提供商以及模型实验室 G.AI 的直接使用相比,Friendly AI 始终快七倍,且错误率显著更低。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, Friendly AI is a core component of the Claude stack.
zh: 今天,Friendly AI 是 Claude 技术栈的核心组件。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can consume this however fits your stack.
zh: 你可以按照适合自己技术栈的任意方式来使用它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Model API is the fastest way to start.
zh: 模型 API 是最快的入门方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: Core Frontier Openweight models through our serverless API.
zh: 通过我们的无服务器 API 使用前沿开放权重模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Dedicated endpoints give you your own isolated deployment with guaranteed SLAs for production workloads.
